title: Seeking critique + help for how I could make this game more enjoyable? I have recorded a commentary with the gameplay to explain.
author: No_Departure7494
selftext:
I should note that, for whatever reason, ever since I ran out of usage on Claude and told ChatGPT to fix a few things - the infantry on the map are less visible so it looks kind of dead.

Ignore the UI, HUD, all of it. It will be fixed in the future.

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body:
"Ignore the UI, HUD, all of it. It will be fixed in the future." 

I would fix it sooner than later.

replies.author: No_Departure7494
replies.body: Of course but I am currently out of usage right now and Astra just makes it worse so it'll have to wait until Monday, haha.

comments.author: mlaclac
comments.body: The scope of your game is so large, but you don't even know what are the objectives in your game. How can you know it's not balanced?

replies.author: No_Departure7494
replies.body: It's just gonna end up being a territorial battle. Either a timed battle and by the end of it, whoever occupies more of the other's enemy territory wins or if the game ends early by pushing the other army back into the sea. I am fine with that for now. By unbalanced I guess I just wanted to get some insight on what vehicles should be reduced. Is it lame to have a ton of fighter jets flying around giving no one else a chance? Should I remove them, add tons of low poly AI infantry masses, etc.

comments.author: SwaggyK
comments.body: This is just slop lol. You basically have to reset and focus on small parts and build it up one by one. quality is what makes games not the idea of it
